{{Top}} {{Otheruses}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Yani-TheChildrenFromTehar.png]] |name=Yani |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Gotal]]{{Resistance|The Recruit}} |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|White]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Gray |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']]{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Yani''' was a [[Gotal]] resident on the ''[[Colossus]]''. ==Biography== ===Enter Kazuda=== {{Quote|Why, he's the greatest pilot in the known ga-a-laxy, Bolza!|Yani|}} Yani was a [[Gotal]] and a citizen of the ''[[Colossus]]''. When [[Neeku Vozo]] mistakenly believed [[Kazuda Xiono]] to be one of the best [[starfighter]] [[pilot]]s in the [[galaxy]], Yani was one of the first individuals Vozo told of Xiono's starfighter pilot expertise. Later at [[Aunt Z's Tavern]], Yani continued spreading the rumor when the Gotal recanted it to [[Bolza Grool]]. While Yani was at Aunt Z's, a fight broke out that involved most of the cantina's patrons. When Yani fell onto the bartop during the brawl, [[Jooks]] dragged the Gotal off the bar. Yani then defended themselves from Jooks. Right before [[Jarek Yeager]] broke up the fight, an object struck Yani in the head and knocked the Gotal to the ground. Yani was present in Aunt Z's when Vozo announced Xiono would race and [[Z'Vk'Thkrkza]] began taking bets for said race. Later in the day, Yani was present to watch a race be won by [[Hype Fazon]]. After the race, the nearby Xiono was introduced to platform by [[Jak Sivrak]] and instructed to select a challenger to race from the [[Ace Squadron|Aces]]. Yani witnessed Xiono picked [[Torra Doza]]. Later, while fetching lunch for [[Flix]] and [[Orka]], Vozo and Xiono passed by Yani conversing with [[Orthog]] in the [[Colossus marketplace|''Colossus'' marketplace]]. The next day Yani watched the [[Race between Kazuda Xiono and Torra Doza|race]] between Doza and Xiono. The Gotal cheered during the race. Later, Yani conversed with{{Resistance|The Triple Dark}} an herb vendor{{Resistance|The Children from Tehar}} in the ''Colossus'' marketplace. When the [[Warbird gang]] attacked the ''Colossus'', Yani ran through a corridor as the platform's defenses deployed. Yani was enjoying a drink at Aunt Z's when the patrons of the cantina took noticed of Xiono [[Mission to Doza Tower|traversing]] the outside edges of [[Doza Tower]]. Z'Vk'Thkrkza began taking bets on Xiono falling. The Gotal cheered with the others when Xiono successfully made a daring jump.{{Resistance|The High Tower}} ===The bounty=== {{Quote|20,000 credits?''"
"''Hah. Some reward for a couple of runaway bra-a-a-ats.|A rodian and Yani|}} Yani discussed a bounty placed on two children, [[Kel]] and [[Eila]], with a [[Rodian]] in Aunt Z's tavern. When the Rodian stated the bounty was worth 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], Yani commented that they would love to find the bounty for that reward. The Rodian theorized the children were on the other side of the galaxy, which Yani refuted that [[Castilon]] was the other side of the galaxy. The Gotal shared a laughed with the Rodian. ==Behind the scenes== Yani first appeared in "[[The Recruit]]," the premiere episode of ''[[Star Wars Resistance]].'' Yani was voiced by [[Bobby Moynihan]], who also voiced [[Orka]] in the series. ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|The Recruit}} {{1st}} *{{Resistance|The Triple Dark}} *{{ResistanceAnimationCite|3|The Triple Dark (comic story)}} *{{Resistance|The High Tower}} *{{Resistance|The Children from Tehar}} *{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} *{{Resistance|The Engineer}} *{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-trailer|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Trailer Revealed}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|Ae2Cxy8sswk|Extended Sneak Peek | Star Wars Resistance|sw_url=video/season-one-trailer-star-wars-resistance}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Yani (Coloso) |fr=Yani |ja=ヤニ |ka=იანი (კოლოსი) }} [[Category:Colossus residents]] [[Category:Gotals]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
